ai_usage_evidence: Throughout the project, I used a structured interaction with AI to progressively transform a collection of research papers into an organized body of knowledge.
summary: The submission contains a CSV edge list and a PDF methodology report covering three tasks: metadata extraction (Task 1), hierarchical topic tree and network graph construction (Task 2), and deep thematic synthesis of divergences (Task 3). It details data preparation, Gephi network analysis, and discusses trade‑offs such as optimization versus adaptability and energy efficiency versus throughput. AI is referenced as part of the workflow, but no specific AI tool is named. Tasks 4 and 5 are absent, resulting in a partial delivery.
issues: Only three of the five expected tasks are present; tasks 4 and 5 are missing.
No specific AI tools are identified despite a claim of AI usage.
The CSV provides edges without an accompanying node file in the submission.
Bibliographic references and full literature matrix are not included in the excerpt.
